# XVIDEOS
> Free adult video streaming platform with category browsing, channels, profiles, playlists, and localized content sections.

XVIDEOS organizes a large catalog of user-uploaded and studio adult videos across straight, gay, and transgender sections. The site structure centers on video discovery pages, category indexes, performer and user profiles, channels, playlists, and upload tools.

## Main Sections
- [Homepage](https://www.xvideos.com/): Main video discovery page with trending, recent, and recommended adult videos.
- [Best Videos](https://www.xvideos.com/best): Ranking page for popular and top-rated videos.
- [New Videos](https://www.xvideos.com/new): Chronological feed of newly published videos.
- [Tags](https://www.xvideos.com/tags): Directory of searchable tags used to classify videos.
- [Channels](https://www.xvideos.com/channels): Index of creator, studio, and branded video channels.
- [Profiles](https://www.xvideos.com/profiles): Directory of user and creator profiles.
- [Pornstars](https://www.xvideos.com/pornstars): Performer directory for browsing videos by pornstar.
- [Playlists](https://www.xvideos.com/playlists): Public playlist directory curated by users and creators.
